Data:Slnev.agdistis.aladim.json.startdescription: Agdistis and al-Adim have a lively chat about the uses of birdsong in the prediction of weather. [Lesson: Furs & Feathers]

Data:Slnev.agdistis.arthur.json.startdescription: Arthur and Agdistis are talking, softly and seriously, about those absences which scar. 'I still miss him,' Arthur says. Agdistis squeezes his hand and quotes in Greek: 'Roses by the head, jasmine at the feet…' [Lesson: Disciplines of the Scar]

Data:Slnev.agdistis.arun.json.startdescription: Agdistis and Arun are discussing the Thunderskin's rites in Phrygia, India, and Cyprus… [Lesson: Drums & Dances]

Data:Slnev.agdistis.azita.json.startdescription: 'You are Sogdian, are you not?' Agdistis asks Azita. 'I was born,' she agrees, 'in the Sogdian twilight, after the coming of ibn Asad, when our language was already passing from the world… but I still recall a few of our songs, if that is what you were going to ask me.' [Lesson: Strings & Songs]

Data:Slnev.agdistis.chaima.json.startdescription: Agdistis is plainly delighted to see Chaima again, and she favours him with a rare smile, bright as mica in moonlight. Again they fall to discussing the dances of the Rif mountains - since they last met, he has travelled there himself to learn of them… [Lesson: Drums & Dances]

Data:Slnev.agdistis.connie.json.startdescription: Connie and Agdistis, unexpectedly, are discussing ouranoscopy: she's intrigued by the ways in which the 'dance' of the Hours and of the heavenly bodies might serve as a source of horomachic information. Agdistis is nonplussed, but does his best to keep up. [Lesson: Ouranoscopy]

Data:Slnev.agdistis.coquille.json.startdescription: Agdistis and Coquille are chatting about opera. He prefers German; she, Italian. [Lesson: Strings & Songs]

Data:Slnev.agdistis.corso.json.startdescription: Agdistis and Corso chat about Solar doctrine. Both of them, it seems, were raised in the Sun: both of them admit to an absurd degree of guilt about their absence from church on the Sun's Day. [Lesson: Sacra Solis Invicti]

Data:Slnev.agdistis.dagmar.json.startdescription: Agdistis recites - with caution - some of the lake-songs of the witches of the Fucine marshes. 'I am more comfortable with the Phrygian tongue,' he says, 'but it is wise to pay the Sister her due.' [Lesson: Fucine]

Data:Slnev.agdistis.douglas.json.startdescription: Douglas has been to a performance of Keirle's Ceaseless - for assessment of oneiric hazard, not for pleasure, but he took Mrs Moore ('free tickets is free tickets') and both enjoyed it - Douglas much more than they expected. Agdistis is more than happy to discuss Keirle's work. [Lesson: Weaving & Knotworking]

Data:Slnev.agdistis.ehsan.json.startdescription: Ehsan and Agdistis are discussing needlework techniques for stitching sigils of healing into closing wounds - or of guidance into costumes. [Lesson: Stitching & Binding]

Data:Slnev.agdistis.fraser.json.startdescription: Fraser hopes to fund a ballet, to help accelerate the development of the Cross-nature in his 'kin under the Cross'; he hopes to employ Agdistis as a choreographer. Agdistis is clearly wary, but clearly tempted. [Lesson: Purifications & Exaltations]

Data:Slnev.agdistis.hokobald.json.startdescription: Agdistis and Hokobald have a scrupulously polite conversation about acoustics, resonance, and bellringing in the churches of London. [Lesson: Bells & Brazieries]
